connector.name: Ainote
connector.registryDescription: Agent-native notes, tasks, dev-docs, vaults, sync & handoffs. MCP + OpenAPI dual surface.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.ainote.dev over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the seunghan91 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: McpKey <YOUR_KEY> -- same key as the AINOTE_API_KEY env var for the stdio transport.

env.name: AINOTE_API_KEY
env.description: 64-character ainote MCP key. Issue one via `npx @ainote/mcp signup` (RFC 8628 device flow), or in a Claude session by calling signup_and_get_key, or at https://app.ainote.dev -> Settings -> MCP keys.
